prompt: In many large cities, ordinary working people can no longer afford to live near the places where they work. Why has this happened, and what can be done about it?
essay:
Nowadays, the price of the houses in the big cities is increasing dramatically and many normal workers can not afford to live near their workplace. This is a serious problem in many countries and in this essay I will explain the reasons and the solutions of this problem.

The first reason of this problem is that many rich people and foreign investors are buying the properties in the city centre only for the investment. They do not live in these houses, so the houses are empty and the price is going up. Secondly, the salary of the normal workers is not increasing as fast as the price of the houses. For example a teacher or a nurse is earning almost the same money like ten years ago, but the rent is double now. Moreover, everybody wants to live in the big city because there are more opportunities of the job there, so there is a big competition.

There are some solutions for this problem. Firstly, the government should build more houses for the poor people and give them with a cheap rent. Secondly, the government should also make a law to stop the foreign people to buy the property. In addition, the companies can allow the employees to work from the home, so they do not need to live in the expensive city. If the government take these steps, the situation will be much better.

In conclusion, the reasons of this problem are the investors, the low salary and the big demand, and the government should build more houses and control the market. I believe that with the correct policies, the normal people can live in the city again.
title: When ordinary workers cannot afford the city
